tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// yi dam dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong rab 'byams kyi gtor chog skor phrin las 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ 'dir yi dam chos skyong la mchod gtor 'bul bar 'dod pas gtor ma sogs spyi ltar bshams la/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zhes pa nas ha ho hrīḥ'i bar gtor chog ltar bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung la gnas pa'i kye rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wā ka tsit+ta oṃ in+da sogs nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā'i bar gtor chog ltar bya/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar/ hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ sogs kyis nang mchod phul/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs/ kye yi rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ de nas rnal 'byor ma/ 'jigs byed/ 'byung 'dul la sogs pa'i yi dam gang byed kyi gtor bsngo byed/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ byin rlabs dran par byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po yum chen e ka dza ṭī dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma lcam dral/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi/ dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma/ las mkhan ming po bcas pa/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring*/ sprul pa'i ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyu mo rgyud pho nya las mkhan/ nor skyong dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa/

'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje/ gnod sbyin zangs kyi bek+tse can/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ 'og min bde chen dag pa'i pho brang nas// rnam snang thugs las sprul pa'i srung ma mchog /bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo rdo rje gur// dpal ldan mgon po 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// snang srid bha ga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag mo dbyings phyug yum// sngags srung drag mo ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso// yum chen ral gcig 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// yongs 'du'i tshal dang gshin rje'i pho brang dang*/ 'dzam gling de wī ko ṭa'i gnas mchog nas// 'dod khams gtso mo nam gru re ma ti// dpal ldan lha mo 'dir byon= /bsil ba'i tshal dang ha ha dgod pa dang*// siṅga gling dang ti se gangs ri dang*// dar lung brag ram kha'u'i brag rdzong nas// zhing skyong bdag po 'dir byon= /rdo rje gdan dang rgyan gong gtsug lag nas// sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul// khams gsum kun la dbang bsgyur 'dod khams ma// rdo rje rab brtan 'dir byon= /bsam gling gnas dang bo dong gtsug lag nas// bstan srung kun gyi gtso mo re ma ti// dmag zor lha mo 'dir byon= /dur khrod brgyad dang lho phyogs ri sul dang*// rdo rje gdan dang dpal gyi bsam yas dang*// nā la rtse dang dpal ldan sa skya nas// las mgon pho mo 'dir byon= /nub phyogs o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas// sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol// ci 'dod dngos grub char 'bebs nor gyi lha// gnas srung yab yum 'dir byon= /ri rab byang phyogs rin chen gzhal yas nas// sa brgyad dbang phyug gnod sbyin tshogs kyi rje// dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs mdzad pa'i// rgyal chen rnam sras 'dir byon= /ri rab byang shar mnyan yod bya gshongs nas// dngos grub nor gyi char 'bebs dbang gi rgyal// bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong ba'i rnam thos sras// dbang gi mdog can 'dir byon=

/lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas// 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi bka' sdod mchog /bstan dgra'i gshed ma zhing skyong ma he'i zhal// chos rgyal yab yum 'dir byon= /byang shar ma ru rtse yi dur khrod dang*// rgya gar bam so dmar po'i brag ri dang*// dar lung brag ram la sogs gnas mchog nas// gnod sbyin lcam dral 'dir byon= /oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā sogs dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra sogs/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la sogs/ oṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ yo gī nī khā hi/ ḍā ki ni khā hi/ s+t+waṃ bha wak+ka ta/ re ma ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs dang*/ bh+yo rak+mo bh+yo/ rak+mo bh+yo bh+yo/ rak+mo thun bh+yo kha la raka chen mo/ rak+mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yo/ ru lu ru lu/ hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum mam lnga/ a li sogs dang*/ oṃ gh+ri rā dza sogs dang*/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya swā hā/ i daṃ sogs/ oṃ dzam+bha lā ya swā hā/ oṃ pūr+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ oṃ saṃ pradz+nyā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ gu ha s+thā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ pañci kā ya swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ye swā hā/ i daṃ sogs/ oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa bai shra ma ṇā ya sarba rat+na tsit+ta rat+na hrīṃ dzaḥ i daṃ ba li ta khā hi khā hi sogs/ oṃ kā la ru pa sogs/ oṃ rak+mo sogs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sogs/ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang bdag cag chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam don chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/

hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// bh+yoḥ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyis ni// 'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas// 'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ma// 'dod khams dbang phyag ma la bstod// hūm̐/ dpal ldan srid gsum dbang sgyur zhing*// mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa'i tshul// mchu 'phyang shugs che drag po'i tshul// gzhon nu'i lus can khyod la bstod// bh+yoḥ o rgyan che dang lo ston la sogs pas// bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong bar bka' bsgos pa'i// 'phrin las thogs med sgrub mdzad bstan srung ma// rdo rje rab brtan 'khor dang bcas la bstod// bh+yoḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo 'dod khams ma// ma rungs bstan dgra 'dul mdzad re ma ti// ma ltar brtse bas skyong ba'i dmag zor ma// ma gcig srid gsum dbang phyug ma la bstod/ hūm̐// dam can gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// bka' bstod pu tra ming sring dang*// ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa// bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas la bstod// hūm̐/ rab 'jigs keng rus khros pa bstan dgra'i gshed// dam tshig can la nor gyi dngos grub stsol// rtsa brgyud bla mas nyer bsten bka' bsgos pa'i// nor skyong yab yum 'khor dang bcas la bstod// rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing*// sprin bral nyi ma stong gi gzi ldan pa// 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs mdzad la bdag bstod do// dbang gi mdangs ldan gnod sbyin tshogs kyi rje// drag shul stobs ldan dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /tshar pa chos rje'i bka' srung yid bzhin nor// 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs mdzad la bdag bstod do/ yaḥ 'jam dpal khros pa dus dgra'i dbang po yi// bka' yi bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa// rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong ba'i srung ma mchog

/dam ldan yab yum 'khor dang bcas la bstod// hūm̐/ gtum chen drag por khros pa'i gad rgyangs kyis// dgra snying shubs nas lkog mar nyer thon cing*// rno dbal ral gri mkha' la 'phyar byed pa// dbang gi skyes bu gnod sbyin bek+tser bstod// gsol lo mchod do rgyal ba'i bstan srung tshogs// bsgrub bo brten no bla ma'i bka' srung tshogs// 'bod do bskul lo rnal 'byor dgra lha'i tshogs// rings pa'i tshul gyis 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor mas mchod// dza gad sman phud rak+ta'i btung bas mchod// rnga chen rkang gling rol mo'i sgra yis mchod// dar nag 'phan chen sprin ltar gtibs pas mchod// rab 'jigs snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ros mchod// yid 'phrog mchod sprin mkha' dang mnyam pas mchod// phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas rgya mtshos mchod// bde stong dbyer med ye shes rol pas mchod// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po khyod kyis srungs// dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyen po khyed kyis bstod// dpal ldan bla ma'i 'phrin las khyed kyis spel// rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod don khyed kyis sgrubs/ yig brgya bzod gsol sogs rjes chog spyi ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung blo gter dbang pos thog ma'i zin chung dang*/ mjug gi sbyar byang brjes nas lung spel zhus pa dge/ ༈ /gtor chog nyung 'dus bzhugs so// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// yi dam chos skyong srung ma la// btud nas de dag mnyes byed kyi// gtor 'bul cho ga 'bri bar bya// 'dir sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kye gnyis dang gur lcam dral zhal bzhi nor skyong zung dkar bdud phur srung bcas la gtor 'bul shin tu bsdus pa'i lag len 'di lta ste/ gur zhal sogs kyi rten yod na de nyid kyi drung dang*/ gzhan ji ltar rigs par stegs steng ras dkar sogs kyis bkab la 'bru snas brgyan pa'i dbus su yi dam gnyis la thun mong du zlum gtor gcig

g.yas su gur nas phur srung yan la thun mong du zlum gtor gcig g.yon du mkha' 'gro spyi dang gzhi bdag thun mong du zlum gtor gcig rnams bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams bsham/ spro na rang gi mdun du stegs steng rdor dril nang mchod ḍa ma ru 'thor nas rnams bshams pa'am/ ma byung yang chad pa'i skyon med/ dngos gzhi la rdor dril bshams tshe/ thog mar mchod pa la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang*/ gzhan yid kyis dmigs la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod du hūm̐ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nyer spyod rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ ḍa dril yod tshe dkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da/ u da pha la ya bi s+phu ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas byin gyis brlabs la ḍa dril bzhag skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ nam mkhar rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dmigs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin can la rang gzhan thams cad skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ ngag tu/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i don du yi dam lha// yongs su bsgom par sems bskyed do// lan gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas spros pa'i khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i zhing 'di rdo rje'i gur khang du gyur pa'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras pa'i lte bar pad+ma nyi zla drag po pho mo'i steng du rang hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gnyis na rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga/

g.yon gnyis na me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mtha' ma gnyis kyis phur bu bsgril bas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dur khrod kyi chas dang*/ dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus rang la thim/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dbang dus kyi dam bca' bzhin bzla/ bzlas tshar ba dang phreng ba la has btab spyi bor reg la/ bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes brjod/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas srung 'khor dang chos 'byung rang la thim/ mdun gyi gtor ma la dmigs te/ gong bzhin a mṛ ta dang swa bhā was bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung dang ram̐ las me'i steng du a las thod pa'i lte bar go ku da ha na las ba lang khyi rta glang chen mi'i sha/ bi mu shū ma ra las dri chen dri chu byang sems klad pa rak+ta/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rim̐ kham̐ hūm̐ las me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya grub chos dbyings ye shes/ de'i steng nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas zhu ba'i rlangs pa phogs pas rkyen byas rdo rje'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu nas gnyis med kyi ye shes bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rdo rje hūm̐ nyi ma dang bcas pa gtor rdzas kyi bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan la hūm̐ las kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/

de'i pang du am̐ las rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i steng du gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ las lha mo brgyad du gyur te gtso 'khor thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kye rdor lha dgu'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ so so'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ badz+ra ni ri ni wi ti sarba saṃ sho dha ni ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha mo brgyad kyis legs mchod pa'i// kye yi rdo rje'i tshogs la 'dud// gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol/ ༈ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sogs dang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa la/ snying ga'i 'od dur khrod brgyad la phog pas cha brgyad du gyur/ ye shes pa 'khor bcas phaiṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs gong bzhin/ ar+gha dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gong bzhin/ brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka /'khor dang bcas la dang bas bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol/ ༈ /nam mkhar dur khrod kyi dbus su pad nyi ro gdan la hūm̐ las nag po chen po gri thod gaṇ+ḍi 'dzin pa dur khrod rgyan can pho nya lnga dang bcas pa'i g.yon du pad zla la e ka dza ṭī sngon mo g.yu bum 'dzin zhing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i lte bar bh+yoḥlas 'dod khams ma bong bu la zhon pa sngo nag phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na gri thod/

g.yon gnyis na mdung rtse gsum dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan zhing ba lang gi ko ba dang re lde'i sham thabs can lcags sgrog gis brgyan zhing zhon pa la nad rkyal cho long khram shing bkal ba/ mgon po'i g.yas su pad nyi ro gdan la hūm̐ las tsa turmu kha sngo dkar dmar ba dud ka'i zhal can g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis gri thod/ 'og ma gnyis gri mdung*/ rus phreng mi rkang gling bu bum pa rnams 'dzin zhing dur khrod kyi chas dang tshangs skud can/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tu g.yung mo/ gtum mo/ srin mo/ siṅga lī rnams sngo ljang dmar ser gri thod 'dzin pas bskor ba/ de'i g.yas su pad zla la hūm̐ am̐ las nor skyong yab yum keng rus dbyug thod 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ lcam dral gnyis kyi mdun du dam nyams kyi ro gdan lnga la/ yam̐ mam̐ tri tri bh+yoḥlas nag po gnod sbyin gri gug nyi ma/ nag mo gnod sbyin spu gri zla ba/ pu tra gri thod/ bha ṭa sher shing snying*/ srin mo spu gri rgyu ma 'dzin pa rnams sku mdog mthing nag dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ lcam dral gyi g.yon du pad zla la bh+yoḥlas dkar mo nyi zla ri rab gling bzhi 'dzin cing dar gos gsol ba/ g.yon du hūm̐ las bdud rgyal rta nag chibs cing lcags mdung thod phreng 'dzin pa dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mtha' skor du dam can bcu gnyis ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas gtor mgron 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya staṃ/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya ma hā kā lī de wī tsa turmu kha sh+ma sha na pa ti badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa kā li yak+ṣi ni yak+ṣa pu tra ru dra bha ṭa ru lu rāk+ṣa si badz+ra shān+tiṃ pad+ma kṛṣ+ṇa ka pā la badz+ra kī la ya dha ti ma ma sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi gsum gyis phul/

ar+ghaṃ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gong bzhin brjod/ bstan pa rin chen skyong mdzad pa'i// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'dud// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs gong bzhin/ phaiṃ/ badz+ra ā ra li ho tshar gcig a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs tshar gsum/ phyi nang gis mchod la/ gnas gsum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ ༈ /byin rlabs gong bzhin/ bhū mi pa ti ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs spyi gtor bzhin/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ nyes byas gang yin bzod par gsol/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swāhā/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dge 'dis sems can ma lus pa// rdo rje 'dzin sa thob gyur cig /mchog gsum srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis// nyin mtshan kun tu bde legs shog /ces pa'ang dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung nyid blo gter dbang pos mchod brjod dang sbyar byang brjes nas lung spel zhus pa dge/ ༈ /bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro bde mchog gi zhing skyong spyi dang 'byung po thams cad gtor ma'i cho ga chen po dngos grub bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/ rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid dang*// 'dzag med dga' chen mnyam sbyor ba'i// bla ma he ru kar btud nas// gtor chen cho ga 'dir bshad bya// de yang bcom ldan 'das bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur thob cing de'i bcas pa la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas gtor ma'i cho ga 'di nyid bsgrub par bya'o// des ni las dang dngos grub la sogs pa 'dod pa'i khyad par shin tu mang po dag 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/

skye bo mang po dag la'ang mchog tu phan pa yin no// de la dus ni/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang 'bral na thun so so'i 'jug gi cha dang*/ lhag par mchog tu bsngags pa ni nam phyed kyi thun mtshams la yin cing*/ khyad par gyi dus ni/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ tshes brgyad dang ni khyad par du// bco lnga dang ni tshes bcu bzhir// grub 'dod rnal 'byor rnams kyis ni// 'bad pas gtor ma sbyin par bya// zhes gsung zhing*/ de dag la yar ngo dang mar ngo'i dbye bas drug dang*/ spyir gtor chog 'di tshes bcu mchod pa'i yan lag yin pas/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis te zla gcig gi nang du nyi ma brgyad pa de dag bsngags la/ lo dus kyi dbang ltar na/ dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu la lhag par bsngags so// de ltar gtor chog chen mo btang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rtsa ba'i sngags bzla bzhin du rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas/ nang mchod blangs te sa gzhi la byugs pa'i steng du thig btab nas chos 'byung srung 'khor dang bcas pas bsgom don bzhin rdul tshon gyis bri ba'am/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sogs yod na'ang legs la/ yang na chos 'byung gi dbus su zlum skor gsum lte ba le tshe dgu dang bcas pa bri ba'am/ de yang ma grub na chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa tsam mo// yang na thig btab nas tshom bu bkod kyang rung*/ yang ras bris med cing rdul tshon bri ba mi lcogs na/ maṇ+ḍal la nang mchod kyis chos 'byung bris pa'i dbus su lha grangs mnyam pa'i me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pas kyang rung ngo*// de nas mchod pa'i gtor ma bsdu na gcig gam gnyis dang*/ 'bring por 'khor lo'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i dgu'am/ rgyas par lha grangs dang mnyam pa te/ gang ltar sha khrag chang dang sgog btsong gis brgyan cing zas bzang dgus sbags pa'o// de las rgyun gyi lag len du ni/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po zhig gi gsung jo nang rje btsun dam pas gnang ba ltar/

dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bum pa chang gis bkang ba'i steng gtor snod kha zas dang dmar gyis gang ba re re/ 'das gtor de ka 'dra ba cig brgyad po'i phyi rol lho phyogs stegs bu mtho ba la 'jog cing*/ thams cad ba dan gyis brgyan pa so sor sgos mchod re dang bcas pa'o// gal te sgos mchod so sor ma lcogs na/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga sogs spyi mthun thun mong du bshams kyang chog par rtogs so// mdun du bdud rtsi ka pā la/ rdor dril/ ḍa ma ru sogs kyang 'du byas la/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ skad cig gis rang dpal he ru ka'i skur gyur par bsam/ de nas nang mchod bdud rtsi ni 'og gi gtor ma byin rlabs ji bzhin pas byin gyis brlab/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ de rnams la nang mchod 'thor la/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du bh+rum̐ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las byung ba/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid/ pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/

ā bar+t+ta ya ā bar+t+ta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pā rā mi ta/ nā da saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho/ ā khaṃ swāhā/ zhes rol mo byin 'bebs kyi sngags dang*/ mchod sprin gyi gzungs ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha nā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi man+t+ro pa/ saṃ kra ma ṇi/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇe bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes sogs ci rigs pa bzlas shing byin dbab bo// de nas bdag bskyed dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs nas/ phag mo gtso rkyang ngam/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i bar rgyas bsdus ji ltar bsgom yang rung ste/ gang ltar bzlas pa dang 'od gsal 'jug ldang gi bar du bya'o// de las mngon rtogs gzhan bsgom tshe sgrub thabs rnams su shes la/ 'dir lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs tsam bshad na/ skyabs sems tshad med sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung gi nang du yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ sum̐ las ri rab brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ rang sems hūm̐ bam̐ las/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po in+d+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba/ lang tsho la bab cing*/ mkhrang bag chags pa'i sku can/ bzhad cing khrol chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo zhing*/ mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gyi rtse mor nor bu/ g.yon ngos su zla phyed/ mdun ngos su sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/

thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ dpa' bo'i dar 'phyangs dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal dang*/ thal ba dang*/ rin po che'i rtse bran dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs bdag can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ pad nyi'i steng du zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dang*/ g.yon bskums pa'i 'jigs byed chen po mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o// yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ sku mdog dmar mo dbu skra grol ba/ ba spu langs shing me tog 'dzag pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub gdengs pa/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ zhabs g.yas yab la 'khril zhing*/ g.yon brkyangs pas 'dod chags chen po'i bde ba la rol pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha/ mgo bor na maḥhi/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu/ phrag par bo ṣa ṭ he/ mig tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ bam̐/ snying gar haṃ yam̐/ khar hriṃ moṃ/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag rnams su phaṭa phaṭa/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rkang brgyad dam/ bsdu na/ chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje sems sogs byas kyang mchog oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mchan/ ༈ /shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du rang sems hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ mgo phreng dang*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ skra grol zhing*/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa skam po'i phreng ba can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs can gyis yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ gi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad bde mchog yab yum gyi rnam par phaiṃ/ zhes spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// mthar rjes gzhigs kyi rim pas 'od gsal du bsdus la/ slar yang skur ldang*/ de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ chu chang nang mchod kyis bran/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla ba phyed pa lta bu kha dog sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa kha dog dmar po 'bar ba ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa shin tu rgya che ba as mtshan pa/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du dbus su na las mi'i sha/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ byang du da las glang po che'i sha/ nub tu ha las rta'i sha/

lho ru ku las khyi'i sha/ sha re re'i steng du dbus su mu las dri chu/ shar du bi las dri chen/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dz+riṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ lhor ām̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/ de'i steng du āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor āḥs brgyan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa'am/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog rlung g.yos me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga 'od du zhu zhing bskol te tha mal pa sbyangs/ de'i rlangs kyi 'od zer steng du 'phros pas/ oṃ mgo thur du lta ba dang*/ zla ba dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'am/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa dang 'dres pas bdud rtsir rtogs par byas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'am rdo rje'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas na/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi bdud rtsi la thim ste/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur pas mtha' med du sbar/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'am/ rdo rje dang zla ba dang oṃ yang lhung ste zhu nas kha dog dang dri ro dang nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ yang yang brjod/ de nas gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams nang du dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi la/

bam̐ las chu khams kyi dkyil 'khor dkar po/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung khams kyi dkyil 'khor nag po/ de'i nang du ram̐ las me khams kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po/ de'i nang du lam̐ las sa khams kyi dkyil 'khor ser po'o// de rnams gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bral ba/ de'i dkyil 'khor nang ma'i lha snam khor yug rim pa gsum gyis bskor ba'i dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba ni ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ro// pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma dang mi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ltar na/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang*/ 'og ma gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ltar na/ phyag dang po gnyis g.yas ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas 'dzin cing gsor ba'i rdo rje dang g.yon bshor gyi rnam pa'i thod khrag 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ drag po chen po sum cu rtsa gsum thams cad kyang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i rgyan dang cha byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// 'dab ma rnams la shar du phrum̐ las mkha' 'gro rgyal dbang ma dkar mo thal mo'i rtse mo khar bcug pa/ byang du phraiṃ las 'bar byed ma ser mo thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag pa/ nub tu phrom̐ las 'jig byed ma dmar mo snyim pa khrag gis gang ba zhal du gsol ba/ lhor phriṃ las g.yo ldan ma'am ngag 'phrog ma sngon mo phyag gnyis gtun shing dang sdigs mdzub can/ bzhi kar yang skra dmar po grol zhing mi ro'i gdan la bzhengs pa/ gcer bu sbrul dang rus pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi'o// de'i phyi rol yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ngo bo khor yug gsum po so sor re mig brgyad dang ldan pa'i/

phyogs g.yon skor mtshams g.yas skor gyis gnas pa'i k+ṣeṃ rnams las byung ba'i gnas srung zhing skyong nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams grub par gyur pa ni/ khor yug dang por/ rab tu rgod pa shing mchog ka dam pa// zhing skyong

'gos 'gyur du/ yum zhi gdong*/ yab dril chen du'ang bshad/ zhi gdong dril bu chen mor bcas// rdo rje 'dzin cing 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas// kol+la gi rir ri rtse la brten pa'i// zhing skyong me zhal dpal chen mo dang bcas// mi mgo 'dzin cing mi ro'i gdan la gnas// dha ra ṇa yul twa la'i shing la brten// gtsigs bde byed ma dang skra gyen zer/ pa chen po skra gyen 'bar mar bcas// rtse g.ya'i mtshon cha zer/ gsum 'dzin cing sid+dhi sim+ba ḍi/ dngul chus gang ba'i snod/ /de bī ko ṭir shing mchog pā ṭa la// lus rgyu chen yang zer/ chen po ni rna ba chen mor bcas// mdung thung 'dzin cing yi dwags gdan la bzhugs// bi ra dzar ni a mra la brten pa'i// ha har bzhad pa skad dod a bhi yod zer/ yum ni mer 'bar ma// ba dan 'dzin cing shing leb la gnas pa'o// e rum̐ ṭa ru kar+ṇi'i shing gi drung*// dril bu sgra can me yi gdong ma gnyis// rdo rje shaka ti 'dzin 'phang mdung zer/ cing phag la zhon// ser ta ta pa/ skye'i gnas su shing mchog dza ṭi te/ ti zer/ /byin pa chen po dmar ser ma dang bcas// gtun shing 'dzin cing yi dwags gdan la bzhugs// e la'i grong du a par dzi ta'i shing*// glang po'i rna ba stobs chen ma dang bcas// zhags pa thogs pas bong bu'i steng du bzhugs// de nas 'khor yug gnyis par/ kha che'i yul du ri bo la brten pa'i// 'jigs sdu gu'i byin can zer/ byed chen mo ba lang rna ba ma// lag na lcags sgrog nor sbyin gdan la bzhugs// ma rung mya ngam thang la brten pa yi// gtsigs rim pa mo yang zer/ pa'i zhal can 'jigs zhal skad dod gar ma zer ba yod zer/ ma lhan cig lcags kyu zhags pa thogs shing ma he zhon// spa shing mū ra la brten na ga rar// mche spu'i byin pa/ rtsa ba'i byin can yang zer/

gtsigs chen po ro langs can mar bcas// thang gshol 'dzin cing mi mgo'i gdan la bzhugs// su war+ṇa ru a shwad tha yi drung*// bum pa'i 'bras bu can dang tsa kum+bhaṇ+ḍe zer/ muṇ+ḍi// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin mi ro'i gdan la 'gyings// dza yan+ta ru khang pa brtsegs pa la// ral pa gsum pa bzhin mdzes bzhin dngas ma zer/ ma dang bcas// lug rgyud 'dzin cing keng rus la gnas pa// pre ta pu rir u dum+bar la// 'jigs par byed pa dril bu ma zer/ lug gdong ma'ang zer/ glog gi gdong mar bcas// gzhal yas khang gnas dbyug pa mdung thung 'dzin// so'u rar ni shal ma li yi nags// kun mdzes dang ni me lce'i gdong ma gnyis// sha chen phung por gri gug mdung thung 'dzin// tsā ri tra ru ka rañja shing la// dril bu chen po ka rañjar gnas ma// mdung thung 'dzin cing 'jam 'bras sdong por gnas/ de nas khor yug gsum par/ o u ḍe yang zer/ rgyan yul du mya ngan med pa'i shing*// zhing skyong sgra drag po stobs chen/ can yum ni lha chen mo// rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin cing 'dre bdud mnan// dza lan+dha rar gser shing la brten pa'i// zhing skyong skyed mig skyes yang zer/ pa zhes bya gtum mor bcas// gri gug 'dzin cing mi ro bdud mnan par byas kyang chog zhabs kyis mnan// k+ṣi ra ka rus sā la'i shing sdong la// ri rab chen po 'jig rten ma mor bcas// ral gri 'phyar zhing me dpung la gnas pa// mā ya pu rir shwa 'byung po'i shing zer/ ṣo ṭa shing drung*// zhing skyong 'jigs pa 'dod pa mo dang bcas// mi ro'i phung por rdo rje shag ti 'dzin// am brai ka yul de ba da dhā tri zer/ ru la// brtul zhugs chen po srul me dang lhan cig /thang gshol ga de'i dbyug pa zer/ thod pa dbyug pa'ang zer/ ga ya 'dzin cing seng ge zhon// rgyal po'i khab tu ni

da li ka zer/ lha gnyen gyi shing gcig yin zer/ li ke shing la// rga ba chen po mi sdug ma dang bcas// rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin cing 'khor lor gnas// bod yul brag gi phug la brten pa yi// zhing skyong longs spyod lhan cig skyes mar bcas// chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing yi dwags mnan// ma la bar ni sbrang rtsi'i shing gi drung*// sna tshogs skyes pa'i yang zer/ dbang phyug dbang bskur ma dang bcas// ro gdan la bzhugs rdo rje tho ba 'dzin// kun kyang las dang mthun pa'i rnam 'gyur dang*// rgyan dang na bza' kha dog 'od zer 'bar// yang na phyogs dang mthun pa'i kha dog bcas// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun gyis bskor bar gyur// yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid 'khor lo'i rtsibs sam re mig so so la bzhugs pa'o// de ltar sa khams 'khor lo'i sgo bzhir hrīḥphraiṃ hi hoḥ mtshams bzhir oṃ gam̐ biṃ iṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor phag mo sngon mo phag gdong can// rab khros mda' gzhu rgyal mtshan thod pa 'dzin// lho sgor zhi ba ma ni dmar mo ste// thod pa lcags kyu kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te 'dzin// nub sgor gzhon nu ma ni ser mo ste// tri shūl ba dan gsum pa gzhu dang mda'// byang sgor tsa muṇ+ḍi ni sku mdog nag /kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa rnge'u chung chang snod 'dzin// byang shar zur du tshangs ma kha dog dkar// 'khor lo dang ni thod pa mda' gzhu bsnams// shar lhor tshogs kyi dbang mo ljang gu ste// rtse gsum thod pa bgrang phreng la du 'dzin// lho nub khyab 'jug ma ni nam mkha'i mdog /'khor lo thod pa zhags pa ral gri 'dzin// nub byang mtshams su dbang mo mdangs 'od zer// shak+ti thod pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa 'dzin// de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa stag lpags kyi na bza' dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i byang shar nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad la/

īṃ iṃ ām̐ yam̐ nam̐ yam̐ kām̐ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'byung por dbang ldan dkar po khyu mchog chibs// phyag na mdung rtse gsum dang thod pa bsnams// shar du sa srung bu la dbang po ser// rdo rje dang ni thod pa phyag gis 'dzin// shar lhor me lha lug la zhon// dmar po phyag na me thab 'dzin// lho phyogs gshin rje nag po ste// ma he'i gdan steng dbyug tho 'dzin// lho nub srin po sngo skya ste// ral gri phyar zhing khyi la chibs// chu srin la gnas chu lha dkar// zhags pa thogs pa nub phyogs su'o// rlung lha dud mdog ba dan 'dzin// nub byang ri dwags steng na gnas// gter bum steng na lus ngan ser// rin po che 'dzin byang du gnas// de thams cad phyag bzhi'i g.yon gyi dang po thod pa bcud kyis gang ba dang 'og ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o// dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i shar nas g.yas skor gyi sum̐ tsam̐ mam̐ bum̐ bṛm̐ shum̐ sham̐ ram̐ keṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du nyi ma dmar ser rta mchog dkar po bcibs// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshan pad+ma phyag na bsnams// zla ba dkar po zla dkyil phyed pas mtshan pa yi// ku mud 'dzin pa ngang pa la gnas shar lhor bzhugs// lho sgor mig dmar dmar po ra skyes la gnas shing*// g.yas pas gri thung g.yon pas mi mgo bzung ste za// pad gdan la gnas gza' lhag ser po bden bral na// mda' gzhu 'gengs shing zhi ba'i lta bas gnas pa'o// nub sgor phur bu ser skya rlung du pa sangs dkar// gnyis ka'ang pad+ma la gnas bgrang phreng spyi blugs 'dzin// spen pa sngo nag rus sbal la chibs rab tu khros// dbyug pa 'phyar zhing khu tshur dkur bsten byang sgor bzhugs// dbang ldan zur du sgra gcan dmar nag srin po'i lus// sprin gyi gseb nas lus stod phyungs te nyi zla 'dzin// de dang lhan cig mjug ring sngon po sbrul mjug can// klu gzugs rab tu khros pas ral gri zhags pa 'dzin// de dag kun kyang rang gi khang pa'i steng na bzhugs// rgyu skar la sogs gdon gyi tshogs kyis rab tu bskor// rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs ldan rang gi dam tshig spyod// dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i phyogs bzhir g.yon skor gyi// bram̐ bam̐ rum̐ kam̐ mtshams bzhir mam̐ ram̐ bām̐ yam̐ yongs su gyur pa las// dbang por tshangs pa dkar po ni// zhal bzhi thod pa bzlas 'phreng dang*// spyi blugs pad+ma 'dzin pa'o// gnod sbyin phyogs su khyab 'jug nag

/phyag bzhi ral gri 'khor lo dang*// thod pa ga de'i dbyug pa 'dzin// gshin rjer drag po du ba'i mdog /mdung rtse gsum pa thod khrag dang*// zhags pa bzlas phreng phyag na bsnams// chu bdag phyogs su gzhon nu ser// gdong pa drug ldan mdung thung dang*// dbyig to thod pa bgrang phreng 'dzin// dbang ldan sa yi dkyil 'khor la// pad+ma la gnas nor 'dzin ma// ser mo gos dkar bum pa dang*// mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya can// byin zar me yi dkyil 'khor la// me lce 'bar ba'i steng du ni// me yi lha mo me lha mtshungs// srin por chu yi dkyil 'khor steng*// char sprin la gnas chu lha mo// mdog dbyibs phyag mtshan chu lha bzhin// g.yo ba'i phyogs su rlung dkyil la// 'tshub ma rlung ras g.yo bas mtshan// der gnas rlung gi lha mo ni// phyogs skyong rlung lha nyid dang mtshungs// de'i phyi rol gzhal yas khang gi sgo'i g.yas g.yon la/ yi ge phuḥyig brgyad las klu chen po brgyad/ sgo'i phyi rol gyi khyams la lha ma yin dang*/ lus srul po la sogs pa'i tshogs dang*/ phyi rol dur khrod kyi gnas la hūm̐ rnams las byung ba'i 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa grub par 'gyur pa ni/ dbang ldan gnas su nag po drag po dkar// khyu mchog la zhon rtse gsum thod khrag 'dzin// rgan byed ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor// shar du drag po chen po glang chen zhon// ser po rdo rje 'dzin cing gdan gnon phyag /rgyal ba ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor// me ru lhas sbyin dbyu gu rtse gsum dang*// ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin dmar ra skyes zhon// nag mo bzang mo la sogs bzhi yis bskor// lho ru nag po sngon po ma he zhon// lag na dbyug pa dang ni mdung 'dzin cing*// zla ba ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor// srin por gtsigs byed sngo nag mi ro zhon// lag gnyis ral gri dang ni phub chung bsnams// mar me ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor// mi sdug kha dog dkar po zhags pa thogs// chu srin la zhon nub kyi phyogs su gnas// drag mo gzugs sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor// rlung du dga' ba las 'das kha dog nag

/ri dwags la zhon lag na be con thogs// thod phreng ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor// byang du log 'dren lcags kyu nor dbyug 'dzin// ser po gnod sbyin mi yi gzugs can zhon// ral gri ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor// zhing skyong gtso bo brgyad la rang mtshungs yum gyis 'khyud cing phyag bzhi'i 'og ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar bas bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa/ 'khor rnams thams cad rang rang gi gtso bo dang 'dra ba las/ ral gri ma la sogs pa bzhi dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ma ni ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan can dang*/ gzhu can ma snying gar 'khyud rgya mdzad pa'o// de ltar gzhal yas khang gi phyi nang dur khrod kyi gnas su dkyil 'khor lha yi rang bzhin srid gsum 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams dang*/ srid pa gsum na gnas pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad byon par gyur/ phraiṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru dang*// rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa// dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa yi// dam tshig ldan pa'i tshogs rnams ni// lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// bden bral tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// gang dag ji snyed yod pa rnams// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis// thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon cig /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*// ri dang brag dang phug gi sa// yul gyi 'dab dang lam dang zhing*// khyad par du ni khang stong dang*// snod dang thang dang sa stong dang*// khyad par chu la gnas pa yi// nag po drag po drag chen po// lhas byin mnyam du bsten pa dang*// nag po gtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang*// dga' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams// rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang*// 'jigs byed lha mo u mas bstod// rgyal dang rnam par rgyal nyid dang*// mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma// nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo// nag sbom ma ste rnal 'byor ma// dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo// drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo// bcu gsum dbang phyug ma dang ni// 'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma// 'jib byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma// drag mo'i gzugs can gzugs chen mo// mche ba gtsigs dang thod can ma// thod phreng phreng can kha ṭ+wāṃ ma// sbrul chen ral gri dgra s+t+wa can// rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma// mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid che// las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma// sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal po che// de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te// rdul med rnal 'byor skyed pa mo// rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis// thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon cig /oṃ kak+ka dha na/ bab+ban+dha na/ khakh+kha da na/ sarba duṣ+ṭa naṃ/ ha na ha na/ gha gha gha ta na/ che ge mo nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas spyan drang*/ oṃ suṃ bha sogs kyis bsang*/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ sh+ya sa ma ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya dṛ sh+ya sa ma ya phaṭa/ ces dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

lan mang du brjod/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ gtor mgron thams cad pa ste srid gsum 'gro ba 'jig rten las ma 'das pa kun kyang dpal he ru ka'i rnam rol kho nar nges pa brtan por bzung*/ slar yang*/ oṃ bī ni badz+rī ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin thog mar/ oṃ dang*/ badz+rī ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sbyar te/ wam̐ se/ mṛ taṃ gi mu ra dze/ ha s+ya/ lā s+ya/ gīrti/ nṛ t+ya/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ rū pa/ spar+she/ ra sa/ dharma dhā tu bar gyi rig ma bcu drug dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'// rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces de nyid lnga pas bstod/ spros pa la dga' na lha so so'i bstod pa sbyar na legs/ bsdu na mi dgos/ rang gi lag pa g.yon par ā li las zla ba/ g.yas par kā li las nyi ma/ snyim pa kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūm̐ sngon po/ oṃ a n+yo3n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmā hūm̐/ oṃ s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā hūm̐/

oṃ ā d+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā hūm̐/ lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ pad skor bya zhing*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki n+yā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan lnga'am bdun la sogs pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs la 'bul/ bar 'dir spro na/ oṃ ḍā ki nī phrum̐ phuḥswā hā/ oṃ dī bi nī phraiṃ phuḥswā hā/ oṃ tsu ṣi ṇī phrom̐ phuḥswā hā/ oṃ kaṃ bo dza phriṃ phuḥswā hā/ sngags de bzhi po'i mthar/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sogs sbyar/ 'jig rten pa'i lha zhing skyong 'byung po rnams la so so'i mtshan sngags sam/ yang na lha so so'i sa bon 'bru drug gi bar du bcun pa la gtor sngags btags nas 'bul ba ste/ de yang thog mar zhing skyong thams cad la lhan cig tu dmigs/ lag pa g.yon gtor snod snying gar 'dzin tshul dang*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub gtor mar bstan nas se gol gtogs shing*/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo gī shwa rī hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun la sogs pas spyir 'bul/ de nas bye brag tu/ oṃ āḥk+ṣeṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ la/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes btags pas gnas srung zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad re rer tshar gsum mam/ bsdu na lan res 'bul/ de bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ la/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha btags la/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol dur khrod na gnas pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba chen po ste zhing skyong drag po brgyad yum bcas mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa gnyis la dmigs te gong ltar rkang 'thon du 'bul/ de ltar gnas srung ba dang 'jig rten skyong ba ste zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags kyi rnam grangs gzhan/

oṃ kak+kaḍha na nas/ swā hā'i bar gong du bshad pa de ka yang yin gsung bas na/ sngags de kho nas re rer grangs gong ltar skabs sbyar gyi zhing skyong rnams la 'bul na'ang legs pa'o// de nas dkyil 'khor nang ma'i sgo mtshams su gnas pa'i ma mo brgyad la 'bul te/ de yang*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā la/ a kā ro btags pa'am/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo gī shwa rī hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ btags pas phag mo la 'bul/ des gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o// oṃ āḥphraiṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥho hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥgam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbiṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.iṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ma mo gzhan bdun gyi sngags so// de bzhin dkyil 'khor gnyis par gnas pa'i phyogs skyong rnams la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥ.iṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.iṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥyam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥn+yam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbām̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥkum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas dkyil 'khor gsum par gnas pa'i gza' dgu la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥsum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥtsam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbriṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥshum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥsham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥram̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ā hūm̐ kam̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dkyil 'khor bzhi par gnas pa'i lha chen po rnams la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥpram̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbiṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥrum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥkam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥlam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥram̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥyam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes pa rnams la gtor sngags sngar bzhin sbyor la/ lha re re bzhin tshar gsum mam/ bsdu na lan gcig gis phul ba sngar bzhin bya/ dkyil 'khor phyi'i sgo g.yas g.yon gyi klu chen po brgyad la sogs par dmigs te/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sa ma ya a dhi pa ti dzum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas 'bul zhing*/ thams cad la thun mong du/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+ma da/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñja tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ ma tī kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta yaṃ/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha/ ma ma sa hā yi ka bha ban+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas phul/ g.yas thod pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon ba dan rtse gdengs pa'i phyag rgyas btab cing*/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥswā hā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pas nang mchod byin brlabs kha gsos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan mang pos g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs 'thor 'bul/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mgron thams cad mnyes par bsam/ spro na/ zhabs bsil/ phyag phyis/ so rtsi sogs kyang 'bul te/ de'i sngags kyang rim pa bzhin/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā ra hūm̐ añca ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ hasta su tsi ye swā hā/ oṃ tam+bu la ye swā hā/ zhes pas so// de bzhin skabs 'dir cho ga rnam grangs rgyas par mos na/ mchod pa gzhan yang mang du bstab/ gang ltar yang mthar rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ na mo bha ga ti/ wī re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalbāg+ni san+ni bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭa kā ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ par+shu pā sho d+ya ta kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dha ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+ra dzi naṃ ba ra dha rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ma hā dhum bran+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yab kyi rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga tī badz+ra bā rā hī bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te/ tre la kya mā te ma hā bi d+yā shwa rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā ba he mahā badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ni a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba shaṃ ka ri nai tra bh+ra ma ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ka rā li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥtra sa ni ma ra ni pra bhe da ni a pa ra dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī mahā yo gi kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi rkang brgyad pa ste/ de ltar dpal he ru ka'i rkang brgyad gnyis dang*/ gong ltar de nyid lnga pa la sogs pas bstod/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs te// dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa yi// dam tshig ldan pa'i tshogs rnams ni// oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*// ri dang brag dang phug gi sa// yul gyi 'dabs dang lam dang zhing*// khyad par du ni khang stong dang*// snod dang thang dang sa stong dang*// khyad par chu la gnas pa yi// nag po drag po drag chen po// lhas byin mnyam du brten pa dang*// nag po gtsigs dang 'jigs byed dang*// dga' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams// rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang*// 'jigs byed lha mo u mas bstod// rgyal dang rnam par rgyal nyid dang*// mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma// nag mo chen mo nag chen mo// nag sbom ma ste rnal 'byor ma// dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo// drag tu sdang dang 'chang ba mo// bcu gsum dbang phyug ma dang ni// 'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma// 'jib byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma// drag mo'i gzugs can gzugs chen mo// mche ba gtsigs dang thod can ma// thod phreng phreng can kha ṭ+wāṃ ma// sbrul chen ral gri dgra s+t+wa can// rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma// mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid che// las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa// sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal po che// de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te// rdul med rnal 'byor skyed byed ma// rdo rje dbang mo 'khor dang bcas// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing rnams la// rab dgyes zhing skyong rig mar bcas// bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad 'byung po yi// tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang*// lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// bden bral tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// gang dag ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod 'byor pa kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las gyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub can gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs shing*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// legs pa thams cad 'grub gyur cig

/nyes pa thams cad med par mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ las so so dang 'brel na de dang de'i las la bskul pa drag tu bya/ de nas rdo rje'i glu 'di blang bar bya ste/ 'gro ba kun gyi mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te// rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas gyis// a re re re gti mug phyugs kyis mi shes so// lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos// sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin// snying rje'i gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol par byos// a re= /gang gis don dam la ni ma bsgom pas// de yis sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin te// a re nang dang phyi yi dbye ba med par gyis// 'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o// a re= zhes bya ba dang*/ hūm̐/ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yin// bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba// bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba la// rab tu rmongs pa bsten par byed/ a la la la la la ho/ a i ā ra lī ho// bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol// rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ a la la la la la ho// dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ a i ā ra lī ho/ rab rgyas mgon po khyed bzhugs mdzod// mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i bde ba stsol// dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod// zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa// bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol// thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod// a la la la la la ho/ a i ā ra lī ho// bde ba spangs pas grol mi gyur// bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol// bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas// chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur// bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod// pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis// bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod// 'di yis mgon po bskul na ni// dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub// snyan cing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni// dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu blangs pas// dri med mkha' 'gro drwa ba yis// gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin// oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis brjod// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig

/sems can thams cad skyon med pa// gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /lha mo tshad ma sogs/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom// khyod kyis dngos po mtha' dag nam mkha' dang ni 'dra bar gzigs// mgon po shin tu lci ba'i chus brlan sems la ni// mdzod cig mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod// gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod// ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun gtso bos bzod mdzad rigs// ces bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// mthar/ mtheb mdzub gnyis bkug ste zlum por byas la sor mo gzhan brkyangs pa mig gi phyag rgya bstan rjes/ pad kor dang lte bar 'khyud rgya byas la mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogs te/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la muḥ ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bdag gi dpral bar thim/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas sa la reg ste/ oṃ āt+ma tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang dang gnyis su med par bsams pa la yid kyis mchod/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ rnam lnga 'dod skor bya/ oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭan gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa gats+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par mos/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma lam gyi bzhi mdo sogs su bskyal/

thams cad kyis sum+bha drag tu brjod/ nang du 'ongs nas gtor skyel ba la bsang chu'am nang mchod kyis gtor/ yon bdag la sogs pa gzhan gyi don du gtor ma btang ba yin na/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang*// dpa' bo rnams la bza' dang btung ba khyod kyis drongs// khyed la rtag tu bsrung ba mchog gi sbyor ba dang*// yang na 'di la 'dod pa dang ni phun sum tshogs par shog /ces pa sogs brjod/ rang gzhan gyi don gang yin kyang thun mong du smon lam ji ltar 'os pa brjod cing*/ dpa' bo gnyis med mchod pas skye ba 'di la ni// sgrib pa zad dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub myur thob shog /skye ba kun tu mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yis// grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro ba nyid gyur cig /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs bcu gnyis su// dam tshig brda dang bde spyod rol pa yis// bu bzhin skyong bas bdag sgrib dag gyur te// bde ba mchog gi sa la 'god par shog /bla ma'i zhabs la rtag tu 'dud byed cing*// rdo rje dbang mo'i zhabs brtan gyur nas kyang*// btsun mo'i shu kra'i tshogs la longs spyod cing*// gsang ba'i pad+ma rol zhing mchod byed shog /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi'i// zhal mthong de yi ngo bor bdag gyur te// 'gro ba bde ba dam pas phongs rnams kyi// nyer 'tsho rin chen lta bur bdag gyur cig /rnam pa mang po'i bsod nams 'di dag kyang*// bdag gzhan dge ba mchog ni bskyed pa'i gzhi// de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'joms pa// 'gro la mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /rnam par rtog pa kun las 'das pa yis// bde chen 'khor lo zag pa med pa'i dbyings// ā li kā li rtog med snyoms 'jug gar// bsags pa'i dge rnams yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang*// yun ring 'gro ba'i don sgrub don la 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang*// gtso bo sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par 'gro ba dbang bskur ba// srid gsum rdo rje rol par lhan cig de yi go 'phang thob par shog

/rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer mtha' dag bsal nas he ru ka gtso mkha' 'gro ma'i// 'khor los yongs bskor rgyal ba bla med ye shes 'byung gnas thar pa dam pa'i grong*// sbyin pa la sogs rnams kyis 'gro ba'i yid la re ba yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog /'di ni shin tu brtse ba che ldan 'phags pa'i dpal 'byor rtag par myong bar shog /ces sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam rnams nges par gal che'o// de ltar rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas gsungs pa'i zhing skyong gi gtor chog rgyas pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nas bshad pa'i 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen po rje btsun dam pa sgrol mgon zhabs nas tha dad du mdzad cing*/ de gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu sdud pa'i tshul yang stsal ba las/ dkyil 'khor gnyis gcig tu dril ba'i 'don cha rje btsun dam pa'i gsung nyid gzhir bzhag kha 'phang phyung zur rnams bkang nas bklags chog mar rang bzo 'bad pas spangs te bgyis pa'o// 'di la gtor dkyil du nag po drag po sogs kho na bkod pa 'jig rten skyong ba'i gtor ma zhes bya zhing*/ zhing skyong yab yum zhe brgyad bkod pa la gnas srung gi gtor ma zhes bya la/ de gnyis bsdoms pas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rgyas pa'am/ zhing skyong gi gtor chog rgyas pa yin gsungs te/ de tshe 'dir yang dkyil 'khor gsum don gyis 'dus pa'o// gal te dkyil 'khor tha dad la mos na rje btsun dam pa'i gsung nyid du blta ba'am/ cho ga 'di nyid steng nas 'byin 'dor byas pas kyang 'grub pa nyid do// 'di ni sngags gsar ma pa'i rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dgongs 'grel ji bzhin te/ 'di dang sgros mthun bod sngags rnying pa'i gzhung mkha' 'gro'i gtor chog ces/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon rgyal ba dz+nyā na sū tra dang*/ bye ma la mu dras mdzad pa'i khyad 'phags zhig kyang snang ngo*/ de ltar gtor ma'i phan yon tshad med par rgyud dang man ngag rnams su rgya cher gsungs pas/

'di la nan tan du byas na 'dod pa'i dngos grub thun mong dang khyad par mtha' dag myur du 'grub par nges so// 'dir smras pa/ sngags rgyud kun nas rab bsngags shing*// 'dod pa'i dngos grub rab ster ba// gtor ma'i cho ga bla med par// grub 'dod rnams kyi cis mi brtson// gtor chog dngos grub mdzad med bum pa bzang*// rgyud rgyal bla ma'i bla ma gsang mtha'i lugs// 'di bkod dge mchis mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun// don gnyis phun tshogs bde mchog myur 'grub shog /ces bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro bde mchog gi zhing skyong spyi dang 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga chen po dngos grub bum bzang zhes bya ba 'di nyid dpal kaḥthog pa'i grub mchog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i gsung blo gter dbang pos mchod brjod dang sbyar byang brjes nas lung spel zhus pa dge/ ༈ /bsten pa'i chos srung rnams la mchod gtor 'bul tshul nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// chos skyong srung ma rnams la mchod gtor bsdus pa 'bul bar 'dod pas gtor ma sogs spyi ltar bshams la/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// dus 'di nas bzung ji srid snying po'i bar// skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ bdag gis bla med byang chub ma thob bar// sems can don du sangs rgyas thob par bya// de yi ched du bcom ldan kye rdo rje'i// zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi// sems bskyed lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor dur khrod dbus// pad nyid bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du// hūm̐ las rang nyid kye yi rdo rje'i sku// zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can zhabs bzhi pa// bdag med yum dang rol pa'i stabs gyis bzhugs// de yi gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum mtshan// de las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa// thogs pa med par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med ro gcig gyur// thugs kar hūm̐ la sngags phreng gis bskor ba// de las 'od 'phros sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje rnams// tshur 'dus bdag gi thugs kar thim par gyur// oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ci nus bzlas/ bcom ldan snying po kye yi rdo rje yis// bdag gis thog med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*// nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa// thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /kye yi rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang*// mchod sbyin gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba'i bdud rtsir gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ rang gi mdun du pad nyi mi ro'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag dang*// rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi phyag gi dbus na bsnams// mi mgo'i do shal rus pa sbrul gyis brgyan// stag sham dar gyi lhab lhub mdzes par spras// pho nya lnga bcas me dpung dbus na bzhugs// de yi g.yon du e ka dza ṭī'i sku// sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis bum pa 'dzin// de yi lto bar 'dod khams dbang phyug ma// bong bu gwa zhon zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma// ral gri thod khrag mdung thung rtse gsum 'dzin// mi ro khar bcug mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad// rin chen las grub pho brang sum brtsegs dbus// pad zla seng ge bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rin chen mang sprul rgyal chen rnam thos sras// btso ma gser mdog rgyal mtshan ne'u le 'dzin// rta bdag brgyad kyi dbus na bzhugs par gyur// lcam dral thugs ka'i yam̐ mam̐ 'phro 'du las// skyes pa'i gnod sbyin yab yum ming sring gsum// ru 'dren sde bzhi lha srin dregs byed tshogs// rngam brjid rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur// mgon po'i g.yas su pad nyi mi ro'i steng*// hūm̐ las nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa// zhabs bzhi 'jigs rung srin po khros pa'i gzugs// gri gug thod khrag ral gri mdung thung 'dzin// mi mgo'i rgyan dang rus phreng stag sham can// dam nyams dgra bo'i steng na bro brdung zhing*// ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ sgra sgrogs pa// yum chen sring mo bzhi yi 'khor dang bcas// me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur// de yi g.yas su dpa' bo dur khrod bdag

/keng rus gzugs ldan dbyug to thod khrag 'dzin// brkyang bskum gar gyi gdug can tshar gcod cing*// nor gyi dngos grub stsol ba'i sku can gyur// mdun du gnod sbyin zangs kyi bek+tse can// pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can zhal gcig pa// phyag gnyis zangs gri glo snying mda' gzhu bsnams// khrag mtsho me dpung dbus na bzhugs par gyur// thugs ka'i sa bon dag las 'od 'phros pas// srung ma 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya ma hā kā lī de wī tsa turmu kha bai shra wa ṇa karma nā tha sh+mā sha na rak+ta k+ṣe ru pu ru ṣa lu he ta i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral dang*// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam sring dang*// zhing skyong gdong bzhi dur bdag yab yum dang*// mthu rtsal thogs med gnod sbyin lcam dral rnams// bdag gi mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// nyes kun zhi zhing dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas// skye 'gro dbang sdud gnod byed tshar gcod cing*// bsam don kun 'grub tshe mthar rab phyin nas// don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /yig brgya lan gsum// ma 'byor nyams sogs 'gal 'khrul ci mchis rnams// thams cad srung ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// mgon po 'khor bcas bdag gi lte bar thim// rten med mgron rnams so so'i gnas su gshegs// bdag gi gnas gsum yi ges mtshan par gyur// sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// zhes sogs bsngo smon rgyas par bya'o// zhes pa 'di'ang rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung blo gter dbang pos thog ma'i zin chung dang mjug gi sbyar byang bsgyur nas lung spel zhus pa dge/

༈ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po thugs dam skong ba'i rim pa khyer bde don tshang yang zab dam can 'dzum zhal bzhugs so// rgyal kun phrin las gcig bsdus shing*// byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs pa// nag po chen por gus btud nas// thugs dam skong ba'i cho ga 'bri// 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i thugs dam skong ba'i rim pa khyer bde don tshang rgyal ba dges pa'i mchod rdzas su bskrun pa la/ brgyad/ bcu bzhi/ nyer gsum/ nyer dgu sogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can rnams la bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam rten sogs 'di'i bris 'bur gyi sku bzhugs pa'i drung stegs kyi khar ras sogs bkab ste 'bru sna tshogs bkram pa'i gzhi la thod pa dum bu gsum pa'am/ lcags sder ram/ zangs/ 'khar ba/ rdza sogs kyi sder ma'am/ stegs gtsang ba'i khar/ nas nag rjen btags kyi phud phye/ chang*/ khrag mar khu/ bum rdzas nyer lnga/ bdud rtsi ril phye dang lhan cig sbrus pa'i dam rdzas rgyan ldan gyi gtor ma gru gsum zur rtse mi rno ba'i ldeb gsum la dbus nag mtha' dmar gyi rtsi byugs mtheb kyu bcad kham phyir bstan brgya rtsas gtor ma'i phyed tsam nub pa'i dkyil dang*/ rtser mar dkar gyi sgor rgyan/ dbus bu ram ma bsgar la leb sbyar dkyil sha ril mtheb rdog tsam rgyab pa/ rtse sgrom mdzad na dbus su thod khrag gaṇ+ḍe/ gri gug rdo rje'i yu ba can rnams brtsegs pa'i mthar me ri mar tshon gser shog sogs gang mdzes/ khyung*/ bya/ rta/ g.yag khyi/ lug mi rnams nag po'i gzugs btsugs pa/ smyug rgod tshigs gsum par rgod sgro gsum mam bzhi bskyon zhing*/ gri lcags kyi mde'u zur gsum pa glang dmar rgyus pas bsdams pa/ dung gi ltong kha mtshal dmar gyis byugs pa'i mgul du dar nag btsugs drung mchod bya'i g.yon nas 'og bzung ba'i thod pa sogs kyi snod du khrag gi mchod yon/

dbang lnga'i me tog gzugs/ rus rkang klad pa/ gu gul spos/ zhun chen bsres pa'i mar nag sgron me'i sdong bu/ ro ras/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus zhal zas zhes smad gsum gcig zlum po/ stod gsum gnyis zur gsum dbal can khrag gis byugs shing*/ me ris brgyan pa/ de'i phyir mchod 'go gong bzhin nas/ chu gnyis/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams zhi mchod/ sgrub pa po'i drung rang gi g.yon nas g.yas su/ nang mchod/ dril bu/ rdo rje/ ḍa ma ru/ 'thor nas rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rnga rol dung dkar/ rkang gling*/ phud skyems/ gu gul/ g.yab dar/ tshogs rdzas sogs ci 'byor bshams la/ thog mar bdag bskyed ni/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying rje dang bcas pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas byas nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// tshar gsum/ tshad med bzhi dkyus 'gre/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi dang*// bdud bzhi brtsegs steng rang nyid ni// dgyes rdor zhal brgyad phyug bcu drug /zhabs bzhi bdag med yum dang rol// phyag mtshan rgyan dang bzhugs stabs sogs// mtshan nyid kun rdzogs thugs kar nyir// hūm̐ yig sngags kyis bskor bar gyur// oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ci nus ljags bzlas ni bdag bskyed do// mchod gtor bsang ba ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'khyil// khro tshogs ljang gu g.yas g.yon gyis// sna tshogs rdo rje des mtshan dril// thogs pa me 'od dang bcas spros// mchod gtor bgegs kun bskrad par gyur// zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas mchod gtor rnams la 'thor tshul dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hās bsang*/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyang*/ zhes pa mchod gtor rnams gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong nyid btsan thabs su bsgom pa ma dag pa sbyong ba la zer/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod pa rnams// a las dum gsum thod pa ni// phyi dkar nang dmar dpral mdun bstan// yangs shing rgya cher hūm̐ zhu las// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo'i rnam pa zhi ba'i rdzas// gzhan yang thod pa de lta'i nang*// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag mtsho dang*// mig dang rna ba sna lce snying*// rus rkang klad tshil bsregs pa'i dud// rkang til mar khur ro ras sdong*// mkhris pa sman sna'i dri chab dang*// sha khrag rus spungs zhal zas rngam// rkang gling thod rnga rol mo'i sgra// gzhan yang rlung me thod sgyed steng*// thod snod yangs shing rgya che'i nang*// ba lang khyi rta glang chen mi'i// sha dang dri chen khrag khu ba// klad pa dri chu bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐ hūm̐ yig ste// ye shes lnga dngos rlung me yis// bskyod pas ro gcig bdud rtsi ni// rnam pa sha khrag rus las grub// dam rdzas rgyan ldan gtor mar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta sa mu dra ma hā pañca in+d+ra gu h+ya puṣ+pe/ ma hā me da gu h+ya dhū pe/ ma hā ma dhū ra gu h+ya ā lo ke/ ma hā ba sa ru dhi ra gu h+ya gan+dhe/ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta bhu dza tha pi pa tha ma hā shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhi drag gi mchod pa'i phyag rgya spyi 'gres mchod pa byin brlab/ phyag g.yon g.yas gnyis bya khyung phyag rgya rnams rim bzhin gtor mar bstan nas 'cha' ba dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin brlab/ rang nyid kye yi rdo rje'i mdun// 'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad dbus su// pam̐ pad ram̐ nyi mi ro'i steng*// hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ mtshan las// 'od 'phros dgra bgegs tshar bcad 'dus// yongs gyur dpal ldan rdo rje che// nag po chen po gur gyi mgon// che zhing cher 'bar sku mdog nag

/phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag ni// thugs kar steng 'og dbus gaṇ+ḍi// dmar zlum spyan gsum mche gtsigs zhal// ljags 'dril rngam sgra khrag rgyun 'dzag /smar smin dbu skra dmar ser brdzes// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// thod rlon khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i phreng*// rus pa'i rgyan drug sbrul gyis brgyan/ stag sham dar gyi lhab lhub can/ mi thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis// ro gdan la 'gying g.yas g.yon rgyab// mdun steng rnams su bya khyi nag /ce spyang sngo dang mi nag tshogs// khyung chen rigs lnga'i 'phro 'du can// ye shes me 'bar dbus bzhugs pa'i// dpral mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐// dkar dmar mthing mtshan rang nyid kyi// thugs ka'i 'od kyis spyan drangs gyur// gu gul tshil chen sogs kyi dud pa/ rnga rol rkang gling g.yab dar sogs dang bcas rol mos byin dbab/ gdung dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes ni// gdug pa 'dul phyir srin po'i gzugs// 'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig can// mgon po 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs bzhugs// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma sūr+ya sha trūṃ bet+ta li ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes pas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dang*/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ka a pash+tsi ma/ kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ/ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇi/ ya ti pra tīdz+nya/ sma ra si ta da/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭa na/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gsum sogs kyis gtor ma bsngo bar gnang nas gong bzhin mchod sngags mtheb srin gyis nang mchod 'bul ba'i stangs ka dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po che// lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor bcas mchod/

bstan 'gro rnal 'byor bar chad srungs// bsam kun yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// ces 'phrin 'chol dang*/ skong ba dngos ni/ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐/ ma dag snod bcud snang ba ji snyed pa// dag pa rab 'byams mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri dang zas// rol mo rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga// bkra shis rdzas rtags ri gling nyi zla sogs// rin chen 'bru sna dar gos sman la sogs// ngo mtshar phyi yi skong rdzas sna tshogs kyis// ma hā kā la 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐/ gsang chen zab mo'i rang bzhin dur khrod gnas// 'jigs rung drag po'i gzhal yas chen po'i nang*// dam nyams phyi nang gsang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi// thod snod yangs par de yi khrag rgyun 'khyil// dbang lnga'i me tog tshil chen dud sprin dang*// zhun chen sgron me mkhris chen sman sna'i dri// sha rus bza' ba khrag gi btung bar ldan// rkang gling thod rnga 'jigs rung sna tshogs sgra// g.yang gzhi'i bla bre glo snying rgyu ma'i 'phan// gdug can gcan gzan shun pa sbrul gdug phreng*// rab gsang rus pa'i rgyan drug dam tshig rdzas// ro dum ro skra'i rnga yab zhwa gos l+h+wam// mig sman mdog sogs nang gi mchod rdzas kyis// ma hā kā la 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ hūm̐/ khyad par rmad byung rang bzhin lhan skyes rdzas// tshad ldan bde skyong dam rdzas bcud kyis phyur// ban+dha lcang lo sbyor sgrol rak+tas gang*// dug gsum gtor snod dmar chen gtor ma rngam// dpa' bo g.yul bsad gri snying rdzas 'khor can// pho rgyud sprin ltar 'tshubs pa'i rnga yab nag /mo rgyud rlung dmar 'du ba'i nal bu'i gseb// gsang mdos pad tshal sde brgyad bung ba'i gsob// phyag mtshan mtshon cha bdud sde'i srog gi gshed// phyi rten bya nag la sogs sprul pa'i 'khor// nang rten sku gsung thugs kyi rnam rol can// gsang rten rgyud gsum dregs pa'i srog gi bcud// mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon sogs// phul byung bstan srung thun mong min pa'i rdzas// ma hā kā la 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/

hūm̐/ thog med dus nas 'khor ba ji srid bar// ma rig las nyon las byung bcas rang sdig /dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs 'gal thar pa'i gegs// ci mchis mkha' mnyam sdig dang lhan cig bshags/ hūm̐/ mgon khyod thugs dam gsang ba bskul ba'i phyir// thugs kar nyi dkyil hūm̐ yig sngags phreng bcas// bdag nyid dgyes pa rdo rje'i 'od kyis bskul// phrin las rnam bzhi'i g.yar dam da dgongs shig /ces rnga rol bzhag nas/ g.yul bsad dud chen phreng ba gzhon nu mas bkal pa'i srad bu dgu sgril phreng thag can mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs/ grangs bzung bcu shad can byin gyis brlabs pa phyag g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi sbyor bas bgrangs la thog mar/ rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i yig brgya ci rigs/ de nas/ oṃ de wa pi tsu sogs gong bzhin ci rigs/ de nas/ oṃ ma hā kā lā hūm̐ phaṭa/ dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya shā sa nā= sogs gong bzhin te/ nye snying bdun ma/ snying po bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa sngags shā sa na rnams las rgyun du nye snying gtso bor mdzad/ drag las la shā sa na gtso bor mdzad cing*/ de yang byad ma kha kha sogs 'dogs can du mdzad do// de ltar ljags bzlas grub pa dang*/ rnga rol sogs bcas/ skul zlog ni/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs thugs sprul srung dbang khyod nyid kyis// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam tshig rjes dgongs la// bdag sogs sdig sgrib nad gdon bgegs kun sol// lung rtogs tshe bsod dpal 'byor legs kun spel// snod bcud phun tshogs 'dod kun dbang du bsdus// bstan 'gror gnod kun da lta nyid du sgrol// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub lhun grub mdzod/ hūm̐/ bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'jig rten la gnod pa'i// gzugs can dam nyams dgra bo'i ngan g.yo dang*// gzugs med lan chags bgegs kyi cho 'phrul gyis// snod bcud ma rungs byed rnams de nyid la// myur du bzlog sgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod// hūm̐/

srid pa'i phun tshogs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal// zhi ba'i dge mtshan spang rtogs mthar phyir stsol// mkhas grub gnyen gcig rdo rje nag po che// 'khor 'das yongs kyi mthu chen mnga' gsol lo// hūm̐/ mi 'gyur mthing mdog chos kun ro gcig zhal// bden gnyis phyag dang gzung 'dzin mtha' gnon zhabs// mchog thun rab stsol rngam brjid cha lugs can// yon tan dpag med gur gyi mgon por bstod// de nas gtor ma la nyin mo yin na spos rengs dang*/ srod tho rangs sogs yin na dpal 'bar btsugs/ phud chang dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ dam can dbang phyug nag po 'khor bcas rnams// ting 'dzin sngags rgyas rnam sprul gtor ma che// bza' bca' ljags myang btung ba khyad par rdzas// ri dang rgya mtsho'i rnam rol 'di bzhes la// bla ma'i sku tshe bsring dang thub bstan spel// de bzhin bshad sgrub sde skyong 'jig rten la// gnod srungs legs spel bdag ltos bcas kun la// rtag tu 'go zhing 'ches pa'i brtse gdung mdzod// ces dang*/ drag rol bcas gtor ma thog kha dang ri gtsang sogs su khyer la phud chang 'thor ba sngon 'gros sum gnyis yar phul/ sum gcig mar zhu ba man ngag tu mdzad do// hūm̐/ gang yang bdag blo'i skyon gyur pa'i// lhag chad nor 'khrul bag med bshags// mdun bzhugs mgon po rang la thim// rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐// dge des gnas skabs don kun 'grub// mthar thug nag po che thob shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum bkra shis kyi// dga' char dbyangs snyan deng 'dir byon// zhes brjod la grol lo// zhes pa'ang dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung blo gter dbang pos mchod brjod dang sbyar byang bsgyur nas lung spel zhus pa dge/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/
